topic: Marketing: our first 30 days when we take charge (kids wear)
lines: Aapke marketing ka har rupay, pehle tees din mein hum kahan lagate hain?
Din ek: store, page aur ads ka poora audit.
Din teen: profile, catalogue aur WhatsApp auto reply theek.
Din saat: pehli reels aur ads live.
Din chaudah: jo chala usme budget badhate hain, jo nahi chala, band.
Din tees: report, orders aur agle mahine ka plan.
Yeh reel kisi seller ko bhejein.
Tees din ka plan chahiye? Comment PLAN.
